 Penguins at Sharks projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 11, 2026 
 Link copied 
 PENGUINS (6-10-2) at SHARKS (8-11-1) 
 10 p.m. ET; SN-PIT, NBCSCA 
 Penguins projected lineup 
 Rickard Rakell -- Sidney Crosby -- Evgeni Malkin
 Tommy Novak -- Ben Kindel -- Egor Chinakhov
 Ville Koivunen -- Hendrix Lapierre -- Justin Brazeau
 Connor Dewar -- Blake Lizotte -- Nick Robertson
 Spencer Stastney -- Erik Karlsson
 Samuel Girard -- Kaedan Korczak
 Declan Carlile -- Kris Letang
 Sergei Murashov
 Arturs Silovs
 Scratched: Jake Livanavage, Ilya Solovyov, Andrei Kuzmenko 
 Injured: Ryan Graves (knee), Trevor van Riemsdyk (lower body), Bryan Rust (lower body), Elmer Soderblom (upper body) 
 Sharks projected lineup 
 Michael Misa -- Macklin Celebrini -- Will Smith
 Mason Marchment -- Alexander Wennberg -- Kiefer Sherwood
 Ivar Stenberg -- Ty Dellandrea -- Tyler Toffoli
 Barclay Goodrow -- Zack Ostapchuk -- Collin Graf
 Darnell Nurse -- Michael Kesselring
 Sam Dickinson -- Jacob Trouba
 Dmitry Orlov -- Eric Pohlkamp
 Yaroslav Askarov
 Alex Nedeljkovic
 Scratched: Nolan Allan, Adam Gaudette 
 Injured: Igor Chernyshov (upper body) 
 Status report 
 The Penguins held an optional morning skate. ... van Riemsdyk, a defenseman, is on the road trip and participated fully in practice but won't play. ... The Sharks held an optional morning skate. ... Wennberg, a forward, did not participate in practice Tuesday, but will play his second straight game after missing the previous 10 with an upper-body injury.
